steps.en: Clone the repository and open a coding agent at its root
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，在根目录打开编码助手

steps.en: Give your game requirement and ask the agent to read the routing guide first
steps.zh: 交代游戏需求，让助手先读路由指南

steps.en: Confirms engine and style, plans chapters and builds a playable whitebox
steps.zh: 确认引擎和画风，规划章节，搭出可玩白盒

component.zh: game_design 技能与引擎 API 文档

steps.en: Approve the quoted cost and export the provider key, or decline for local models
steps.zh: 同意报出的费用并导出密钥，或拒绝改用本地模型

steps.en: Generates assets, checks them visually and swaps them into the engine project
steps.zh: 生成资产、做视觉检查，替换进引擎项目

steps.en: Builds, plays, records a short gameplay video and fixes until the review passes
steps.zh: 构建、游玩、录短视频，修到审查通过

value.en: A playable game slice in your chosen engine with generated assets and a review video, without wiring each generator and engine API yourself
value.zh: 在所选引擎里拿到带生成资产和审查录像的可玩切片，不用自己逐个接生成器和引擎 API
